title: Medication Authorization Incident Report Form
subtitle: An original operational incident report for medication authorization that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Medication Authorization Incident Report Form supports the complete medication authorization workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Medication Authorization Incident Report Form when the assigned medication record coordinator needs one fillable record for supplied medication directions, custody, administration authority, exceptions, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Medication authorization incident report identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this incident report to one supplied medication directions, custody, administration authority, exceptions, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Medication authorization record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Medication authorization scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Medication authorization incident facts and immediate condition
sections.guidance: Record direct observations, reported information, exact times, and unknowns without blame or diagnosis.

blocks.label: Medication authorization incident indicators
items: Wrong student, medication, container, or record selected
Dose, route, timing, or condition differed from the approved direction
Medication unavailable, expired, damaged, spilled, lost, or contaminated
Missed, refused, delayed, incomplete, or vomited administration
Unexpected symptom, allergic concern, adverse response, or emergency
Unauthorized access, self-carry, transfer, or administration concern
Documentation, count, custody, storage, or temperature variance
Guardian, qualified reviewer, poison service, or emergency contact required

blocks.label: Event time, location, and information source
Chronological facts, exact words when necessary, source of each fact, unknowns, and observed impact

fields.label: Chronological facts, exact words, source, unknowns, and observed impact

blocks.label: Response and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records medication authorization and custody; it does not prescribe, interpret, change, or guess a medication, dose, route, timing, diagnosis, or response. Use only current guardian authorization and qualified directions under applicable policy. Stop administration on any mismatch or uncertainty, use emergency services when indicated, protect privacy, and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Medication authorization people, property, records, and evidence
sections.guidance: Collect only information needed for response and follow-up; use approved restricted storage.

blocks.label: Property, system, document, or evidence references
Conflicting reports, missing records, unavailable evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

fields.label: Conflicting reports, missing evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

sections.title: Medication authorization response, notification, and operating decision
sections.guidance: Document the action actually taken, why it was selected, who authorized it, and what remains unresolved.

blocks.label: Immediate actions and safeguards
items: Stopped or limited the affected medication authorization activity, movement, or release
Protected the child, participant, volunteer, or affected person from further exposure
Used emergency services or the qualified response route when indicated
Reconciled identity, roster, headcount, item, or custody status
Notified the assigned medication record coordinator and authorized guardian-facing route
Preserved objective facts and minimum-necessary evidence
Protected private records and restricted sensitive information
Established a temporary medication authorization control and accountable follow-up owner

blocks.label: Medication authorization incident operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized medication administrator.

sections.title: Medication authorization review, exception ownership, and corrective follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve questions as questions and assign evidence, correction, and recipient follow-up.

blocks.label: Open question, action, owner, due point, and review
Reviewer observations, corrections to the initial record, limitations, and rationale for final disposition

fields.label: Reviewer observations, corrections, limitations, and disposition rationale

blocks.label: Incident exception and escalation indicators
items: Medication administration cannot proceed from the current record
Guardian authorization or qualified direction is incomplete
Student, medication, label, dose, route, timing, or condition does not reconcile
Authorized staff, storage, supply, or required setting is unavailable
Immediate reaction, overdose concern, illness, or emergency response is active
Administration, inventory, custody, or guardian handoff remains unresolved

sections.title: Medication authorization outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Medication authorization closeout controls
items: Medication status and administration record accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved variance or follow-up has an owner
Medication and related equipment returned to approved custody
Emergency, health, pharmacy, or program follow-up linked
Medication record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Incident Report closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
